items.title: Lam Research (LRCX) Names Kim Tae Won To Lead Korea Operations
items.summary: Lam Research (NasdaqGS:LRCX) has appointed Kim Tae-won as the new head of its Korean operations. Kim Tae-won is an internal hire with a long tenure at Lam Research and a technology focused background inside the group. Lam Research has deep ties with major Korean chip producers, making leadership of the Korean unit important for regional execution and customer engagement. The appointment of Kim Tae-won to lead Lam Research Korea is important, yet investors should weigh several other factors...

items.title: Cathie Wood and 73 Other Funds Bought Chip Stocks. Cerebras Is Down 59% Since. Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCathie Wood’s ARK and dozens of other funds held Cerebras (CBRS:NASDAQ), Intel (INTC:NASDAQ), KLA (KLAC:NASDAQ), Applied Materials (AMAT:NASDAQ), or Lam Research (LRCX:NASDAQ) as of June 30, and all five stocks have fallen 53% to 59% since. Cerebras was a new holding for every fund that owned it.
